checks.description: Actual compiled preflight uses only readonly target admission; compile excludes write branch and preserves guards.
Distinct signed purpose and mode enforced across preparation/build/arm/composition; write default unchanged.
Confirmed-marker return and uncertain-marker stop tested; documentation preserves physical and full-write pending gates.

constraints.text: Permit preflight_only only with commissioning+trusted-initramfs+recovery-handoff. Reject synthetic/claim_only/fault/selftest combinations that bypass real admission. In the actual compiled preflight exclude all reachable O_RDWR and whole-device/environment transfer write paths, rather than relying on a runtime dry-run boolean. Retain exact board/CID/controller/dev_t, trusted entry/root/source-mount, signed-job freshness, bundle checks and one authenticated claim. Recheck target identity at O_RDONLY open, exact block type/capacity/dev_t, validate both exhausted job-token-bound redundant environment records, and close descriptor on every pass/refusal before finalization. Read-only target admission does not imply marker/stager metadata operations are read-only.

Enforce signed sv08-h616-signed-preflight-v1 for preflight and reject it in ordinary write builds; preflight rejects signed-reimage-v1. Keep otherwise unchanged strict descriptor fields, canonicalization, signature verification, source hashing during physical preparation, expiry/RTC prerequisites and signed descriptor/challenge-bound one-shot receipt validation. Bind purpose/mode and actual binary/initramfs/FIT hashes across builder manifests, preparation/service arming and composition; unsigned labels cannot select authority or override signed purpose. Default write builds/jobs retain their previous format and guards.

Each eventual physical preflight has its own fresh job ID/expiry, isolated durable claim state and ephemeral job/receipt key pairs used only by the reviewed nonwriting artifact. Never reuse, consume or rearm an actual write job/claim. Keep private keys in coordinator-only ignored paths and out of boot artifacts, tests/commits/logs; only verification keys belong in the artifact. No real job/key preparation is part of this offline implementation; physical preparation requires fresh Linux/RTC evidence and existing authority. Claims remain consumed on uncertain response, with no retry or automatic rearming.

Preflight return RB_AUTOBOOT is permitted only after the actual marker was durably consumed AND recovery successfully unmounted; uncertain unlink/fsync/syncfs/unmount/rmdir or any earlier refusal retains POWER_OFF stop. Use a distinct PREFLIGHT_PASS, never full-write PASS or CLAIM_ONLY_PASS. Postconsumption pass/refusal may return only after closing target descriptors and using retained absent-marker original recovery fallback. A returned reboot syscall pauses forever without retry. Do not weaken ordinary full-write finalizer statuses or error stop behavior. Test uncertain-marker/unmount paths, descriptor closure and no relaunch/claim reuse.

Use native actual-C harnesses with captured target-open/close/transfer/finalizer syscalls, valid/corrupt/mismatched copies of both environment records, marker durability/unmount faults and pre/postconsumption refusal cases. Demonstrate compile-time mode rejection and signed cross-purpose rejection through preparation, service arming, build and FIT composition, including unchanged write defaults. Reuse unchanged bulk QEMU, one-shot claim and absent-marker U-Boot fallback evidence at its original scope. Independently verify delivery before any physical commissioning. Tests and artifact receipts do not establish actual H616 boot/reset or recovery response.

Keep one implementer and exactly these eleven owned files: tests/fixtures/sd-network-root/emmc_image_writer.c; scripts/build_h616_reimage_candidate.py; scripts/build_h616_recovery_handoff.py; scripts/prepare_h616_reimage_job.py; tests/test_h616_reimage_candidate.py; tests/test_h616_recovery_handoff.py; tests/test_prepare_h616_reimage_job.py; docs/hardware/host-h616-physical-preflight.md; scripts/stage_h616_recovery_handoff.py; tests/test_recovery_handoff_stage.py; tests/test_h616_live_stage_cli.py. The three added files are owned only for the shared purpose-binding repair and its stage/journal/arm/activation regression tests. scripts/live_h616_recovery_stage.py remains an unchanged consumer; return a concrete out-of-ownership production gap to the coordinator before editing. Document the explicit urh-04 O_RDONLY wording reconciliation without modifying accepted hardware results or declaring their checks passed. urh-04 requires separately reviewed measured entry/identity/marker/raw-environment/recovery-return evidence; original recovery GUI return is not normal-slot health or SSH proof. urh-05 full write/readback remains separate and follows urh-04. Actual p5 metadata staging, boot-policy arming and preflight boot each require exact target/artifact/recovery/preservation evidence, applicable standing owner authorization and immediate independent Sol/high review where uncertainty persists. No hardware action, new dependency/source download, kernel/loader/MCU or production service change is authorized by this decision.

Measure scratch under 512 MiB and aggregate retained artifacts under 64 MiB; no full source/image copies or repeat full-image transfer tests. Record FIT/initramfs size and boot-memory impact against existing load-address/resource constraints. Preserve existing recovery files and rollback artifacts, persistence/idle/heater/8 GB/profile/pinning requirements. Stop on resource or preservation violations; retain documented retirement when supported recovery/update testing replaces this helper.

At the actual shared staging verifier, validate signed job format against strict compiled-bundle mode and artifact-composition mode before recovery/journal mutation. Bind the actual writer bytes and extracted initramfs/FIT contents to reviewed build hashes; agreeing unsigned labels alone cannot establish compiled purpose. Reject cross-purpose jobs, write binary relabeled preflight (including self-consistent recomputed unsigned manifests), inconsistent or nonboolean mode fields, changed bundle/artifact/journal, stale job and invalid signature. Exercise positive preflight and default write admission through this verifier and unchanged live-adapter stage/arm/activation revalidation consumers using disposable fixtures and captured mutation boundaries. Journal/build hash checks must preserve mode across later operations. Do not weaken target admission, signature, freshness, source, marker-last staging, preservation or one-shot guards to pass these tests.

Complete representative offline composition with retained pinned kernel, DTB and base initramfs, the actual compiled preflight writer and actual append/FIT machinery, with fixture-only signatures and inert nondeployable job/claim inputs. Record input provenance/pins, toolchain, source revision, compiled writer and final initramfs/FIT sizes/hashes, uncompressed initramfs size, fixed load intervals/nonoverlap and conservative bounded working-memory accounting against existing 64 MiB FIT ceiling/load addresses and 1 GiB H616 budget. Measure composition peak scratch and retained aggregate output; remain below 512 MiB scratch and 64 MiB retained, retain compact receipts and at most the fitting final FIT, and remove only assigned disposable intermediates after hashing. Preserve historical candidates/evidence and rollback files. If required inputs are unavailable, request their specifically assigned development-resource intake from the coordinator; if limits cannot be met, return measured minimum for a separate bounded allocation. No downloads, full images or repeated bulk/QEMU run are authorized. This establishes artifact-size and static resource evidence only: physical relocation, actual memory reliability, entry, marker/identity/raw-environment behavior and return remain urh-04, and full write/readback remains urh-05.

Preserve fafb87a02fbc9a25c3e910842af3628e9b00e0fe and its failed independent verification with original identities/hashes; this approval does not retroactively pass delivery. Submit repaired clean-commit evidence for a fresh independent verifier who is neither author, planner, repair approver nor implementation/evidence producer. Record requested role/model/effort separately from unavailable effective telemetry; the coordinator must satisfy the agent-guide runtime confirmation or explicit recorded fallback before relying on the review as confirmed Sol/medium certification. No hardware action or expanded role authority follows from design approval.

decision.rationale: Approve the bounded delivery repair within existing writerless requirements and decision 0011 delegation, retaining the original seven constraints except the expressly replaced eight-file ownership limit. Reviewed actual current proposal and both requirement files, original approval, unchanged failed candidate fafb87a, scripts/stage_h616_recovery_handoff.py:100-125 and stage_mounted_recovery, scripts/live_h616_recovery_stage.py:_verify_job/arm_live_target/activate_live_target, candidate builders and commissioning_bundle/append_commissioning_initramfs, and formal verification-20260930/verification.json. Before: verify_signed_stage_bundle calls verify_signed_job with the default signed-reimage purpose; the failed controlled-time offline probe reports a correctly signed preflight refused while default write passes. After: the same supported staging route admits the signed nonwriting purpose only when actual reviewed compiled bundle and composition agree, and unchanged later consumers revalidate it; ordinary signed write admission and guards remain strict. The three additional owned paths directly close ppf-02, not a product or authority expansion. The signed-purpose boundary needs tests against actual binary relabeling, not merely two matching manifest booleans. Resource before: tiny mocked append with 22-byte kernel/25-byte initramfs and 1360-byte FIT cannot establish representative sizes. After: real append/composition with retained pinned inputs provides actual writer/initramfs/FIT sizes and static load/working-memory accounting. docs/design/unattended-emmc-reimage-handoff.md records a prior 48,900,464-byte FIT from reviewed 33 MiB kernel/15 MiB base initramfs, supporting feasibility within the existing 64 MiB FIT and 512 MiB scratch limits; new exact measurements remain required. That prior resource measurement and miniature fixture are offline evidence at their stated scope, not proof of this repaired artifact or physical H616 relocation. No upstream replacement is needed for a purpose argument at this custom signed-job integration boundary; the existing pinned upstream build/append/FIT mechanisms remain used, while the documented commissioning-helper retirement remains applicable. Source-backed design evidence, prior offline execution evidence and prospective repaired offline measurements are distinct from pending measured hardware urh-04/05. Accepted requirement contents retain source/target admission, original recovery and rollback, persistence, idle/heater, 8 GB/profile/pinning requirements and separate hardware/release authority; no changed owner requirement, spending, dependency, license or expanded authority is approved. Main afacc6d has only the deliberate proposal edit; candidate worktree remains preserved. No experiments, hardware/credential/private-backup access or source modifications were performed in this review. Requested review settings are recorded honestly as unobserved effective runtime settings; coordinator runtime confirmation/fallback remains required.
